subject.title: UI/TUI: session-recap block leaks into visible user message rendering

question: Should maintainers wait for https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/252 to be rebased, or replace/adopt it in the target repository because it is conflicting and not maintainer-modifiable?
rationale: The bug and fix boundary are clear, but the only open implementation candidate cannot currently merge cleanly and maintainers cannot directly update that fork branch.

options.title: Ask for a rebase
options.body: Keep the issue paired with the open fork PR and ask the contributor to rebase it onto current main with maintainer-modifiable settings if possible.

options.title: Replace the uneditable PR
options.body: Open or adopt a narrow replacement PR in the target repository, credit the source work, and close the fork PR after the replacement exists.

options.title: Wait without action
options.body: Leave both items open until the contributor updates the fork PR, accepting that the source-reproducible rendering bug remains unresolved meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Replace the uneditable PR
recommendation.body: Open or adopt a narrow replacement PR in the target repository, credit the source work, and close the fork PR after the replacement exists.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original shared sanitizer path and authored the TUI leading-only stripping follow-up, making them the strongest routing candidate for this shared UI/TUI boundary decision.
